liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bobby sounds very hoarse on Looks Like Rain [18]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The Scarlet introduction is called one of the hottest of 1985 [14]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire on the Mountain is praised as a great version, and the second set as phenomenal [14]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 other source): The encore U.S. Blues featured a 'let Phil sing' chant [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Day Tripper**: rare: 6 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-02-20.110930.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 132 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd85-02-20.sen441.lai.5303.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 128 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording regarded as exceptionally good, though the first track of each disc suffers SBE errors; Audience recording has great ambience [8][18]
- **gd85-02-20.sbd.miller.21917.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 136 min; rated 2.72/5 by 18 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds excellent in quality; Soundboard recording sounds fine, but Jerry's vocals sound strained and drugged to this listener; Soundboard sound quality is top notch; the reviewer hears Bobby's voice as the one with problems, like a cold [11][12][13][16][19]
- **gd1985-02-20.164501.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 136 min [4]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the vocals of Bobby and Jerry were fine, but the band's energy was low and laid back [17]
- Reviewer says Kaiser shows were generally freak shows [18]
- Uploader dedicates the release to Sandy, nicknamed Bigfoot, who is missed [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-02-20.110930.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Beyer M160 & 1 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [1]
- **gd85-02-20.sen441.lai.5303.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Alan Powell; source: aud>>senn 441>>cassette master>>cdr [2]
- **gd85-02-20.sbd.miller.21917.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD ->Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> Cassette -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [3]
- **gd1985-02-20.164501.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90) [4]. Also: Master cassettes came from Bob Wagner; Charlie Miller handled the transfer, with Joe B. Jones assisting on pitch correction; A Sennheiser 421 source from Mark McCue and Alex Ford supplies a 2:01 patch in Drums [4]
